# A test reads an entry of a window's menu, `c.main.menu[1].children[3].checked`,
# as the one entry its call site wrote: the loop's variable bound to the list at
# the index, an entry before or after the loop counted by the records and the
# const's length. It rebuilt every entry instead, each handler with it, and a
# handler writing what an instance built at run time reads carried that
# instance's updates into the test, `UpdateComponent`, which no test emitter
# has. Here the handlers write the var an effect in the instance under the `if`
# is keyed on. testdata/window_menu.txtar denies the rebuilt list.

sngl test --platform=none app.sngl
stdout 'ok   3 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=html app.sngl
stdout 'ok   3 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=bubbletea --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok   3 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=fyne --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok   3 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok   3 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=android --language=kotlin app.sngl
stdout 'ok   3 tests, 0 failures'

-- app.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import "sngl:test"

const sizes = ["Small", "Medium", "Large"]

var size = "Medium"

component badge ui.node {
    var seen = ""

    effect(on=size, @update(s) {
        seen = s
    })
    ui.text #label(value=seen)
}

component app root {
    var open = true
    var autosave = false
    var saved = 0

    ui.window #main(title="Sizes") {
        component menu {
            ui.menuItem(label="File") {
                ui.menuItem(label="Save", @select { saved += 1 })
                ui.menuItem(label="Autosave", checked=autosave, @select { autosave = !autosave })
            }
            ui.menuItem(label="Size") {
                ui.menuItem(label="Default", checked=size == "Medium", @select { size = "Medium" })
                for var s = sizes {
                    ui.menuItem(label=s, checked=s == size, @select { size = s })
                }
                ui.menuItem(label="Huge", checked=size == "Huge", @select { size = "Huge" })
            }
        }
        ui.button #toggle(text="toggle", @click { open = !open })
        if open {
            badge #b
        }
    }
}

app()

func testAPickedEntryIsChecked(t test.Test, c app) {
    t.assert(c.main.menu[1].children[2].checked && c.main.menu[1].children[0].checked)
    c.main.menu[1].select()
    c.main.menu[1].children[3].select()
    t.assert(c.b != null && c.b.seen == "Large")
    t.assert(c.main.menu[1].children[3].checked && !c.main.menu[1].children[2].checked)
    t.assert(!c.main.menu[1].children[0].checked)
}

func testAnEntryAfterTheLoopIsChecked(t test.Test, c app) {
    t.assert(c.main.menu[1].children[4].label == "Huge" && !c.main.menu[1].children[4].checked)
    c.main.menu[1].select()
    c.main.menu[1].children[4].select()
    t.assert(c.b != null && c.b.seen == "Huge")
    t.assert(c.main.menu[1].children[4].checked && !c.main.menu[1].children[3].checked)
}

func testAToggleEntryFollowsItsState(t test.Test, c app) {
    t.assert(!c.main.menu[0].children[1].checked)
    c.main.menu[0].select()
    c.main.menu[0].children[1].select()
    t.assert(c.autosave && c.main.menu[0].children[1].checked)
}
